rows.label: HAZE
rows.clue: Atmospheric moisture or dust or smoke that causes reduced visibility

rows.label: SWAMP
rows.clue: Low land that is seasonally flooded

rows.label: QUART
rows.clue: A United States liquid unit equal to 32 fluid ounces

rows.label: SCENE
rows.clue: The place where some action occurs

rows.label: YONDER
rows.clue: Distant but within sight (`yon' is dialectal)

rows.label: DOME
rows.clue: A concave shape whose distinguishing characteristic is that the concavity faces downward

rows.label: NONE
rows.clue: A canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise
